items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I remember one band that you were in... that was the Perry Como band. I remember Bob Haggart was the bass player. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That was a good band. Had Willy Roland on the piano, Terry Schneider on the drums.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think of another one. Well, what about Billy, Billy Butterfield?

Well, we worked together in Benny Goodman's band and Billy is one of the most beautiful ballad players I ever heard. He made a record of 'What's New?', when Haggart first wrote it he called it, 'I'm Free.' There was a trumpet solo and I think it ranks right along with Bunny Berrigan's good record of 'Can't Get Started.' But Billy, when he played jazz, bothered me. He would sound good for a while and then he would do what I would think was something trivial, you know, get silly or something. I never liked his jazz…
